title: How do you profile a slow .NET API?
description: Use MiniProfiler, dotTrace, or Visual Studio Diagnostic Tools to find bottlenecks.

data.text: **Question:** How do you profile a slow .NET API?
Profile with MiniProfiler for in-app metrics, dotTrace for deep CPU sampling, and Visual Studio Diagnostic Tools for memory and concurrency analysis.

items: MiniProfiler: lightweight, shows SQL queries and timings
dotMemory: heap snapshots and leak detection
Visual Studio Diagnostic Tools: integrated CPU and memory
PerfView: ETW-based CPU and GC analysis
